query: what is my go-to database for prototyping a side project

seed_memories.content: What is my go-to database for prototyping a side project: SQLite via rusqlite. Zero ops, file-backed, WAL gives plenty of concurrency for read-heavy hobby projects, and migrating to Postgres later is straightforward if scale demands it.
seed_memories.summary: Go-to prototyping database for a side project: SQLite plus rusqlite.
